Mobility project

My goal is to complete a semester abroad at a university in Quebec, Canada, to deepen my skills in artificial intelligence and embedded systems, as I aim to work in the aeronautics industry. I already know the region from an international ice hockey tournament in Montreal and Quebec City, and I was drawn to its culture and landscapes. Positive feedback from friends who studied in Canadian universities confirmed my choice. This experience would also let me improve my English in an academic and professional setting.

Destination: Canada (Quebec)

Period: semester 7 or 8

Right from the start of my engineering program, I had the chance to take part in a "Climate Fresk" workshop with other ENSEEIHT students. It was an eye-opening experience that highlighted today's climate challenges and the critical role we must play as future engineers.

Through ENSEEIHT and the universities of Toulouse, I had the opportunity to take part in the "Futur Proche" festival. The event featured numerous talks and workshops that raised my awareness of climate issues, particularly through current and emerging scientific innovations.
